name: AscentixRulesImport
description: Imports Ascentix Rules Engine rules from a rule package file into a Dataverse environment.
helpMarkDown: Imports each rule in the package one at a time and reports created, updated, unchanged, conflicting and colliding rules.
author: Ascentix

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Power Platform service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The service connection for the environment to import into.

inputs.name: ruleSets
inputs.label: Rule sets
inputs.helpMarkDown: Rule set names, one per line. Defaults to every rule set in the package.

inputs.name: dryRun
inputs.label: Dry run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Validate and report what would happen without changing the target.

inputs.name: targetChanges
inputs.label: Rules changed in the target
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when the target rule was changed after it was last imported.

inputs.name: missingRules
inputs.label: Rules missing from the package
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do with target rules in the selected rule sets that are not in the package.

inputs.name: ownerTeam
inputs.label: Owner team
inputs.helpMarkDown: Team name that owns newly created rules.
